summary.en: Let Floatboat route each task to a suitable model and fall back when needed.
summary.zh: 让 Floatboat 为每项任务选择合适模型，并在需要时自动降级。

title.en: Start with the task, not the model menu.
title.zh: 从任务出发，而不是从模型菜单出发。

description.en: Auto Mode weighs reasoning depth, context size, modality, and response speed, then keeps the result in the same workspace.
description.zh: Auto Mode 综合判断推理深度、上下文规模、输入模态与响应速度，再把结果留在同一个工作空间。

title.en: Different work calls for different strengths.
title.zh: 不同任务，需要不同能力。

description.en: Auto Mode selects a route by what the request actually demands—not by one permanent favorite.
description.zh: Auto Mode 根据请求的实际需求选择路径，而不是永远使用同一个偏好模型。

description.en: Planning, proofs, architecture, and difficult debugging.
description.zh: 规划、证明、架构设计与疑难调试。

description.en: Repositories, research collections, and long documents.
description.zh: 代码库、研究资料与长文档。

description.en: Screenshots, diagrams, images, and mixed inputs.
description.zh: 截图、图表、图像与混合输入。

title.en: One request, three decisions behind the scenes.
title.zh: 一次请求，背后完成三步判断。

description.en: Floatboat identifies the required depth, context, and modality.
description.zh: Floatboat 判断所需推理深度、上下文和模态。

description.en: It selects a suitable model and can fall back if that route is unavailable.
description.zh: 系统选择合适模型，并在路径不可用时自动降级。

description.en: Files, rules, and output remain attached to the same project.
description.zh: 文件、规则与输出继续留在同一项目中。

question.zh: 可以覆盖 Auto Mode 的选择吗？

answer.en: Yes. Select a model directly when repeatability or explicit control matters.
answer.zh: 可以。当可重复性或明确控制更重要时，可直接指定模型。

question.en: Does one request go to every provider?
question.zh: 一次请求会发给所有供应商吗？

answer.en: No. Auto Mode selects a route; it does not broadcast the request to every model.
answer.zh: 不会。Auto Mode 会选择一条路径，而不是向所有模型广播请求。

question.en: What happens when a route is unavailable?
question.zh: 首选路径不可用时怎么办？

answer.en: Auto Mode can choose a suitable fallback so the task can continue.
answer.zh: Auto Mode 可以选择合适的降级模型，让任务继续进行。

title.en: Let the task choose the route.

description.en: Use Auto Mode when finishing the work matters more than managing a model roster.
description.zh: 当完成工作比管理模型名单更重要时，使用 Auto Mode。
